# Arcade Points by ePlus.DEV

> Community tools for Google Skills Arcade: score calculation, badge tracking, prize-slot visibility, current swag tracking, and sourced historical reward archives.

## Primary pages

- https://arcade.eplus.dev/
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/guide/
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/about/

## Swag archive

- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/ — Swag archive by season
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2025/ — 2025 Season 1 and Season 2 historical tier packages with source links

## Arcade 2026 swag

- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/ — 2026 reward overview by tier
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/trooper/ — Arcade Trooper rewards and prize slots
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/ranger/ — Arcade Ranger rewards and prize slots
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/champion/ — Arcade Champion rewards and prize slots
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/legend/ — Arcade Legend rewards and prize slots
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/swag-drops/2026/weather-shield-jacket/ — Weather-Shield Jacket reward detail

## Monthly Arcade labs

- https://arcade.eplus.dev/monthly-labs/ — Recorded months, newest first
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/monthly-labs/2026/09/ — September 2026 lab/game records
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/monthly-labs/2026/09/game-7441/ — An official game record with description, code, deadline and source links

Month pages use `/monthly-labs/YYYY/MM/`; detail pages add an official `game-ID` or reconstructed `badge-…` slug. Archived place counts and access codes are captured records, not live enrollment guarantees. Ended labs and missing source fields are explicitly identified. Descriptions remain in the official source language; individual lab steps are not invented from game summaries.

## Discovery

- https://arcade.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/robots.txt
- https://arcade.eplus.dev/agents.md

## Notes

Google remains the authority for final Arcade scores, reward eligibility, prize allocation, and official swag announcements. The 2025 Season 2 package is verified against Google's official final wrap-up. Season 1 is reconstructed from official item announcements and clearly labeled supporting evidence where a standalone official reveal could not be located. Historical rewards must not be presented as current-season rewards.
